Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238123
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53872 of 2023

Applicant :- Abhilash Arya
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Nand Kishore Singh,Prashant Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Prashant Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shatrughan Yadav,
learned AGA for the State-respondent.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
258 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC & section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Rath, District Hamirpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 7.3.2020 and after marriage, applicant and his family members tortured her for additional demand of Rs. Ten lacs and on 1.6.2023 father of the applicant informed the informant that they have taken his daughter to CHC Rath and when informant and his family members arrived there then found that his daughter has died.

Abhilash Arya vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4888712/

sentences.text: It is further mentioned in the FIR that due to the non fulfilment of the demand of additional dowry applicant and his family members committed murder of the daughter of the informant.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture he has been made accused in the present matter.
6.

He further submitted that actually deceased and applicant both cleared TET examination but unfortunately in spite of their best efforts they could not get any job and thereafter applicant had to run an online shop and deceased had to become an agent and their financial condition was not good and as from the wedlock of the applicant and deceased one child was also born, therefore, she remained under depression with regard to the financial condition.

7. He further submitted that deceased even before her death was in continuous medical treatment with regard to the her depression and her medical prescription have been annexed as annexure-17 to the affidavit.

8. He further submitted that due to depression actually deceased committed suicide by hanging herself and immediately after incident, father of the applicant rushed her to CHC Rath where doctor declared her dead and this fact is even evident from the FIR as well as from the statement of the informant recorded during investigation.
9.

He further submitted that after receiving information informant side arrived at spot and thereafter inquest proceeding was initiated and at the time of inquest even informant and applicant including his father and other family members were present and father of the applicant and even informant were one of the inquest witnesses and this fact is evident from inquest report dated 1.6.2023 but next day i.e. on 2.6.2023 FIR of the present case was lodged after cooking up the false story of demand of dowry and torture.
10.

He further submitted that even after the incident applicant tried to file a complaint to the police but when he could not succeed then he filed a complaint with regard to death of his wife through on-line portal (grievance cell) on 2.6.2023 and this fact is evident from annexure-18 to the affidavit.
11.

He further submitted that however as per post mortem report deceased died due to hanging but her hyoid bone was found broken but sometime in cases of suicidal death also hyoid bone may be found fractured and therefore, merely on the basis of the fact that hyoid bone was found fractured at this stage, it cannot be, said that it is a case of homicidal death, considering the opinion of the autopsy surgeon.
12.
He further submitted that all these facts indicates that applicant is innocent and he tried his best to save the life of his wife but unfortunately she died.
13. He further submitted that applicant is having no previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 5.6.2023 i.e. for last more than six months.

sentences.text:
14. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within three and half years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.
15.

He further pointed out that however deceased died due to hanging but doctor noted that hyoid bone of deceased was found broken and therefore, it appears to be a case of homicidal death,
however he could not dispute that even in case of suicide hyoid bone can be found fractured.
16.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

17. Applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within three and half years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.
18. However, from the post mortem it reflects that deceased died due to asphyxia as a result of hanging but doctor also noted that her hyoid bone was also found broken.

19. In case of suicidal death generally hyoid bone is found intact but sometime in cases of suicidal death also hyoid bone can be found broken, therefore, at this stage opinion of the doctor can not be disbelieved.

20. Further, from the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant and other material available on record it reflects that immediately after the incident father of the applicant has taken the deceased to the hospital where she was declared dead and even FIR of the present case was lodged next day and on the same day i.e. on 1.6.2023 when inquest was conducted then father of the applicant and even informant both were present and they were inquest witnesses and at that time,
informant did not raise any objection with regard to the death of the deceased.

21. From the entire material available on record the defence taken by the applicant cannot be completely ruled out at this stage, considering the medical prescriptions of the deceased which have been annexed alongwith the instant bail application which indicate that she was under medical treatment due to her depression.
22. Further applicant is having no previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 5.6.2023 i.e. for last more than six months.

23. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant who is although husband of the deceased is entitled to be released on bail.
24. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

25. Let the applicant- Abhilash Arya, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned Abhilash Arya vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4888712/
3 with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
26.

27. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
